confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general regional knowledge; local venues can be cheaper than tourist areas, and July accommodation prices vary. Cocktail and wine estimates use a tourist-bar premium relative to local draft beer; wine is especially uncertain because of import pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Pattaya's Thai beach-resort and nightlife market, with local restaurant prices broadly comparable to Bangkok's tourist districts and accommodation carrying a seaside-tourism premium.
